body: The bread sits dry but pale powder lines the water bottle. A tissue shows the same dust. The sprayer rig still sits in the adjacent row.
title: bread, water bottle and tissue

body: One work boot is stuffed with newspaper from the closure day. A numbered tag is laced to the other boot. The tag matches a list I saw at the checkpoint.
title: Work boots and newspaper

body: There are fresh drops on this cloth over a smear of fertilizer dust. The dry cloth tied beside it has none.
title: Ripped sheets and fertilizer

body: A lunch bowl has grain husks stuck to its rim. The unopened bread beside it looks packed for the same shift.
title: Bowl and bread

body: Dark treated-feed dust covers the outer sleeve of this jacket. A bottle inside has the same residue at its neck. A scorched crop leaf is in a pocket.
title: Camo jacket and water bottle

body: A full bottle is knotted to a cloth strip with a brown stain. A scorched leaf of seed corn lies beside it. The cloth has a dusting of sprayed powder.
title: Water bottle and ripped sheets

body: The hand shovel has fresh field soil. A cloth on its grip is stained green from the sprayer. A bandage was laid out but never used.
title: Hand shovel and bandage

body: A numbered tag is clipped inside this purse. The spoon beside it has tape marked with a count. I think they were taken at a checkpoint and dropped.
title: Purse and spoon

body: The olive jacket reeks of pesticide. White residue stains both cuffs and collar. Crushed crop leaves cling to the fabric. The tissue in the pocket is still folded.
title: olive jacket and tissue

body: The soap, dish gloves and water bottle share one numbered tag. The tape on the bottle reads 'Hold'. I think a patrol left them.
title: soap, dish gloves and bottle
